Trump says son will repay Russian oligarch for wedding costs

Former US President Donald Trump stated that his son, Donald Trump Jr., has informed him that he will repay a Russian oligarch for wedding expenses. The oligarch reportedly funded parts of a multi-day wedding celebration for Trump Jr. in the Bahamas. Trump Jr. had previously defended the gift without mentioning repayment. Democrats in the US Congress have launched an investigation into the matter.
